title: 第八百七十二章 大阵仗第八百七十一章 蜂拥
lines: “什么，走海路？让我走海路回去？”
说这话时，者山君那张脸简直是煞白煞白，别说血色，就连魂都快丢了。不只是他，就连一旁陪侍的礼曹参议，那也是魂飞魄散，就差没有跪下来恳求张寿去帮忙求情了。而得到张寿那确定的答复，者山君终于忍不住双腿一软，整个人往前就是一个踉跄。
幸好张寿眼疾手快，一把扶住了这个瘦弱的未来高丽王，这才没有让人直接一头栽在地上。而等到看见礼曹参议颤抖得如同筛糠，他就清了清嗓子，随即语重心长地说：“当然，朝廷会派人护送你们回去，与你们同行的，还有众多勋臣贵戚子弟。”
这一次，者山君的脸上终于恢复了一点点血色，而刚刚震惊到忘了在未来大王面前献殷勤的礼曹参议，也是终于醒觉了过来。他挤出了一丝笑容，小心翼翼地问道：“张学士，敢问这是怎么回事？”
“你们高丽的使节，年年都会到大明来，相较之下，大明派人去高丽，往往只会是册封等等大事的时候，以至于朝中上上下下，多数人都说不清楚高丽到底是个什么状况，年轻一辈就更不用说了。所以，皇上打算遴选一批勋臣贵戚子弟，让他们到高丽好好看看。”
听到这里，礼曹参议终于深深舒了一口气，但者山君虽然年纪小，此时想得反而比旁边这位高官更多，因此，他在满脸惶恐谢过张寿的搀扶之后，就小声问道：“老师，天朝派出这些勋臣贵戚子弟，他们是打算看什么？”
“看民生，看风情，看官制，主要是好好磨一磨他们的骄娇二气。”张寿才不管这年头有没有骄娇二气这种说法，微微一笑后就反问道，“怎么，难道高丽还有什么见不得人的东西，不能让这些公子哥们看看？”
“那绝对没有！”这一次，赌咒发誓似的接过话茬的，是礼曹参议。他虽然心中气恼者山君太不会说话，但脸上还不敢带出来，只能赶紧对张寿赔笑道，“天朝能够派一些贵介子弟去我国看看，我国自然是不胜荣幸。只不过，我国不比天朝富庶，恐怕他们会失望。”
“看一看别人家的江山和子民，对比大明的天下和子民，他们可以对这寰宇有一个更深刻的了解。当然，要是你们觉得是大明趁着这机会打算探听你们高丽虚实，那也可以上书对皇上提出异议。反正到时候所有人的名单会开列出来，你们可以看个清楚。”
者山君顿时面色一变，而礼曹参议赶紧解释道：“断然不敢这么想，张学士您别误会！我国为大明藩属多年，一向恭谨守礼，而天朝使节也往来不绝，国中没有什么秘密不能给人看的！只不过，我朝毕竟不富庶，万一对诸位公子招待不周……”
他稍稍停顿了一下，见张寿仿佛没听懂自己的意思，他就咬了咬牙，把话说得更透彻了一些：“如秦国公长公子那般眼睛里揉不得沙子的，恐怕会有所不便。”
说来说去，原来是担心张琛这个地位尊贵的喷子！
如果不是要保持自己淡然若定的人设，这会儿张寿简直就要笑喷了。想想张琛也实在是够有牌面，喷过上任高丽王，又喷过即将登上高丽王位的者山君，也难怪高丽人对于这位心里发怵，唯恐人跟着去之后横挑鼻子竖挑眼睛。
他呵呵一笑，随即就若无其事地说：“张琛当然不会去，他最近忙着呢，正在那拉着一大堆人，推演宋金大战和宋元大战是否可能因人和各种外力而产生变局。不过，带头去高丽的那个家伙也姓张，也是我的一个学生，正是襄阳伯之子。”
张寿随口报出了几个人名，大多是朝中官员之子，礼曹参议一边听一边琢磨，但随即就陡然想到自己千方百计打听到的某些状况。
传说这位张学士能够在京城立足，就是因为他给一大批原本郁郁不得志的贵介子弟提供了机会，而这些人大多不是家中嫡长子，甚至根本就是庶子。和自己的国家不同，大明的庶子也许在继承爵位上一样没份，但在其他地位上却高得多。
也就是说，去往高丽的那一批人，哪怕出自贵幸之家，但很可能都是旁支庶子之类的角色，说不定还是能够被轻轻巧巧放弃，说不定还能利用这些人闹出什么事件，而后归罪于他们！想通了这一点，礼曹参议刚刚好转的脸色，此时瞬间又发白了。
于是，他立刻开口问道：“那除却这些人之外，请问可还有其他人同去？”
张寿一听就知道，礼曹参议心里还是怕得要死。可这年头海上风险绝大，就连二皇子那样的，尚且都会沉船之后落在一群不明根底之人的手中，更不用提别人了，所以这些个怕死的高丽贵人生怕被沉了海，那也可以理解。
他也没打算藏着掖着，就这么气定神闲地说：“兹事体大，虽说之前已经去了信使送了问罪书，但皇上还是决定再派出使者。二皇子虽说被除宗籍，按理应该只是庶人，可我们上上下下尚且都还这么敬称一声，更可见皇上作为君父的心情。”
“所以，此次同船而行的使团副使，自然不是什么无名之辈，而是渭南伯。”
渭南伯是谁？者山君听张寿灌输了满脑子的华夏古代史，可反而对于大明如今得用的官员没有太多的了解，所以听到这个爵位，他只觉得满满当当都是陌生。
而礼曹参议就不会像自家未来大王这样小白无知了。他轻轻吸了一口气，满脸不可思议地说：“渭南伯张康？掌管军器局的那位？”
等张寿微微点了点头，他这才一下子惊醒了过来，慌忙赔笑道：“对不住对不住，我实在是一时吃惊，这才叫了渭南伯大人的名字……哎呀，听说渭南伯这几十年来一直都是宠臣，执掌军器局，深得天子信赖，想不到他此次会是副使……”
说到这里，他陡然喉头一滞，恰是心头悚然。
渭南伯张康这样的人都尚且只是副使，那么正使是谁？难不成皇帝会派出一部尚书这样的重臣前往高丽吗？要是那样的话实在是太隆重了，说实话他都觉得有些承担不起！
content_en:
"What, take the sea route? Let me go back by the sea?"
When he said this, Zheshanjun's face was so pale that he almost lost his soul, not to mention the color of his blood. Not only him, but also Councilor Li Cao who was accompanying him was so distraught that he almost knelt down and begged Zhang Shou for help. After receiving Zhang Shou's affirmative reply, Zheshanjun finally couldn't help but his legs softened, and he stumbled forward.
Fortunately, Zhang Shou had quick eyesight and quick hands, and he supported the thin future King of Korea, preventing him from falling directly to the ground. When he saw that Councilor Li Cao was shaking like chaff, he cleared his throat, and then said earnestly: "Of course, the imperial court will send someone to escort you back. You will be accompanied by many honorable ministers and nobles."
This time, a little color finally returned to Zheshanjun's face, and Councilor Li Cao, who had just been so shocked that he forgot to show his courtesy in front of the future king, finally woke up. He forced a smile and asked cautiously: "Scholar Zhang, may I ask what is going on?"
"Your envoys from Goryeo will come to the Ming Dynasty every year. In comparison, the Ming Dynasty will only send people to Goryeo for major events such as canonization, so that most people in the court and up and down can't tell what the situation is in Goryeo, let alone the younger generation. Therefore, the emperor plans to select a group of noble ministers and descendants and let them go to Goryeo to have a good look."
Hearing this, Counselor Li Cao finally breathed a deep sigh of relief. However, although Zheshanjun was young, he was thinking more than the senior official next to him. Therefore, after thanking Zhang Shou for his help with fear on his face, he asked in a low voice: "Teacher, what do they plan to see when the heaven sends these honorable ministers and nobles?"
"Look at people's livelihood, style, and officialdom. The main thing is to temper their arrogance." Zhang Shoucai didn't care whether there was such a thing as arrogance these days. He smiled slightly and asked, "Why, is there anything shameful about Goryeo that these young men can't see?"
"Absolutely not!" This time, it was Councilor Li Cao who took over the words like he was swearing. Although he was angry that Tiger Tiger couldn't speak, he didn't dare to show it on his face. He could only smile quickly and said to Zhang Shoupei, "It is a great honor for my country to send some noble disciples to visit our country. However, our country is not richer than China, so I'm afraid they will be disappointed."
"Looking at other people's kingdoms and people, and comparing them with Ming's world and people, they can have a deeper understanding of the world. Of course, if you feel that Ming is taking this opportunity to find out about your country, you can also write a letter to raise objections to the emperor. Anyway, everyone's list will be listed by then, and you can see clearly."
Lord Zheshan's expression suddenly changed, and Councilor Li Cao quickly explained: "I definitely don't dare to think so, Zhang, don't get me wrong! Our country has been a vassal of the Ming Dynasty for many years, and we have always been respectful and observant of etiquette. Envoys from the Celestial Dynasty also come and go. There are no secrets in the country that cannot be seen by others! However, our country is not rich after all, so if we don't treat you well..."
He paused for a moment, and seeing that Zhang Shou didn't seem to understand what he meant, he gritted his teeth and spoke more clearly: "I'm afraid it will be inconvenient for someone like the eldest son of the Duke of Qin who can't get sand out of his eyes."
After all, it turned out that I was worried about Zhang Chen, a troll with a high status!
If he hadn't kept his calm persona, Zhang Shou would have burst out laughing at this moment. Thinking about Zhang Chen's reputation, he has criticized the previous King of Koryo and the Tiger King who is about to ascend the throne of Koryo. It is no wonder that the Koryo people are afraid of this person, fearing that others will follow him and pick up their noses and eyes.
He chuckled, and then said nonchalantly: "Of course Zhang Chen won't go. He has been busy recently. He is dragging a lot of people there to deduce whether the Song-Jin War and the Song-Yuan War might change due to people and various external forces. However, the guy who took the lead to go to Goryeo also had a surname of Zhang. He was also one of my students, and he was the son of Uncle Xiangyang."
Zhang Shou casually reported the names of several people, most of whom were sons of officials in the DPRK. Counselor Li Cao listened and pondered, but then suddenly thought of some situations he had tried his best to find out.
Legend has it that Academician Zhang was able to gain a foothold in the capital because he provided opportunities to a large number of Guijie's descendants who were originally frustrated, and most of these people were not the eldest sons of their families, or even concubines at all. Unlike his own country, the concubines of the Ming Dynasty may have no share in inheriting the title, but their other statuses are much higher.
In other words, the group of people who went to Goryeo, even if they came from the noble family, were probably all bastards and so on. They might still be given up by Qingqiaoqiao, and they might be able to use these people to cause some trouble, and then blame them! After thinking about this, Councilor Li Cao's face, which had just improved, suddenly turned pale again.
So, he immediately asked: "Aside from these people, are there anyone else going with you?"
Zhang Shou knew as soon as he heard this that Councilor Li Cao was still scared to death. But these days, the risks at sea are extremely high. Even the second prince will be shipwrecked and fall into the hands of a group of unknown people, let alone others. Therefore, it is understandable that these Goryeo nobles who are afraid of death are afraid of being sunk into the sea.
He didn't intend to hide it, so he said calmly: "This is a serious matter. Although the emperor has sent a messenger to deliver a confession before, the emperor still decided to send another messenger. Although the second prince was expelled from the clan, he should be a commoner, but we still address him with such respect, which shows the emperor's mood as a king's father."
"So, the deputy envoy of the mission traveling on the same ship this time is naturally not an unknown person, but Uncle Weinan."
Who is Weinan Bo? Zheshanjun listened to Zhang Shou filling his mind with ancient Chinese history, but on the contrary, he didn't know much about the officials used by the Ming Dynasty today, so when he heard about this title, he just felt that it was completely unfamiliar.
And Councilor Li Cao would not be as ignorant as his future king. He took a deep breath and said with a look of disbelief on his face: "Weinan Bo Zhang Kang? The one in charge of the Arms Bureau?"
When Zhang Shou nodded slightly, he suddenly woke up and hurriedly said with a smile: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I was really surprised for a moment, so I called Mr. Weinan Bo by his name... Oh, I heard that Mr. Weinan Bo has been a favorite minister for decades, in charge of the Arms Bureau, and has won the emperor's trust. I didn't expect that he would be the deputy envoy this time..."
When he said this, his throat suddenly stopped, and his heart felt horrified.
People like Weinan Bo Zhang Kang were only deputy envoys, so who was the chief envoy? Is it possible that the emperor would send an important minister like a minister to Goryeo? It would be too grand to do that, and to be honest, he felt he couldn't afford it!
